mintAuthority.summary: USDO has issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Base, and BNB Smart Chain. The issuer EOA holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADE_ROLE on all three tokens, and Ethereum also has the USDOExpressV2 direct-minter path. The three CCIP pools and the unresolved Plasma-route pool are bridge machinery assessed only under Bridge Risk, not independent native issuance.

review.evidence: Current native issuance review performed 2026-08-16. OpenEden's official registry identifies Ethereum, Base, and BNB Smart Chain as native USDO deployments. At Ethereum block 25770581, Base blocks 50064709 and 50064763, and BNB blocks 116351303, 116351386, and 116351442, issuer EOA 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADE_ROLE on all three token deployments. Ethereum USDOExpressV2 0x80e49d1bdce8f80c38e88dd5c4c004ddb9b4e887 remains a separate direct-minter path. The three issuer EVM proxies are UUPS-style with zero EIP-1967 admin slots and implementations 0x87e3ba929c71c0e28fc1c817d107a888a59c523e, 0xf7a045e51f858d5ccb107c1723df1ffb888fceea, and 0x4fec3fe2ad9d8a3616b622ef703b26f411e146a2; no token-level economic cap was established. The Ethereum, Base, BNB, and provisional Plasma CCIP pools have bridge-only mint/burn roles and are excluded from native posture evidence and retained under Bridge Risk. At Plasma block 29978329, the issuer EOA lacks DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADE_ROLE; the official OpenEden and Chainlink registries map the authored address to Kaia rather than Plasma, so no Plasma native issuance is claimed. Existing reserve recomputability, periodic reconciliation, and BMA prudential supervision evidence remain unchanged.
